welcome:
Welcome to the Ansible CLI Playground.
Type commands to explore a simulated Ansible control node.
Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

steps.instruction: First, check connectivity to all hosts in your inventory.
Good — web-03 is unreachable. Check just the webservers group to confirm.
Let's see the full inventory graph to understand our host groups.
Run the deploy playbook in check mode first to preview changes without applying them.
Looks safe. Now run the actual deployment across all hosts.
web-03 failed. Run the playbook again targeting only that host to retry.
Still failing — check web-03's facts to diagnose the issue.
The host is back. Verify all webservers are responding with an uptime check.
Create a new encrypted vault file to store production secrets.
Now encrypt an existing variables file that contains plain-text credentials.
View the encrypted file to confirm it's protected.
Run the deploy playbook, providing the vault password at the prompt.
Security audit requires a password rotation. Rekey the vault file with a new password.
Decrypt the prod vars file temporarily to update a value.

commands.ansible-doc apt:
ansible.builtin.apt  —  Manages apt-packages

  DESCRIPTION:
      Manages apt packages (such as for Debian/Ubuntu).

  OPTIONS:
      name (required):
          A list of package names to install, upgrade, or remove.
          Type: list / elements=string

      state:
          Desired package state.
          Choices: absent, build-dep, fixed, latest, present (default)

      update_cache:
          Run apt-get update before the operation.
          Type: bool / Default: no

      cache_valid_time:
          Update apt cache if older than cache_valid_time seconds.
          Type: int / Default: 0

      force_apt_get:
          Force usage of apt-get instead of aptitude.
          Type: bool / Default: no

      install_recommends:
          Install recommended packages.
          Type: bool / Default: null (use apt config)

  EXAMPLES:
      # Install the latest version of nginx
      - name: Install nginx
        ansible.builtin.apt:
          name: nginx
          state: present
          update_cache: yes

      # Remove a package
      - name: Remove apache2
        ansible.builtin.apt:
          name: apache2
          state: absent

      # Install multiple packages
      - name: Install packages
        ansible.builtin.apt:
          name:
            - nginx
            - postgresql
            - redis-server
          state: present

  SEE ALSO: ansible.builtin.yum, ansible.builtin.dnf, ansible.builtin.package
